title: Road Widening
statementMd:
Mayor of city S just hates trees and lawns. They take so much space and there could be a road on the place they occupy!

The Mayor thinks that one of the main city streets could be considerably widened on account of lawn nobody needs anyway. Moreover, that might help reduce the car jams which happen from time to time on the street.

The street is split into $*n*$ equal length parts from left to right, the $*i*$-th part is characterized by two integers: width of road $*s*_{*i*}$ and width of lawn $*g*_{*i*}$.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1e351a64cc735b32c3ed5bd9304d0d528a12a83e.png)

For each of $*n*$ parts the Mayor should decide the size of lawn to demolish. For the $*i*$-th part he can reduce lawn width by integer $*x*_{*i*}$ ($0 ≤ *x*_{*i*} ≤ *g*_{*i*}$). After it new road width of the $*i*$-th part will be equal to $*s*'_{*i*} = *s*_{*i*} + *x*_{*i*}$ and new lawn width will be equal to $*g*'_{*i*} = *g*_{*i*} - *x*_{*i*}$.

On the one hand, the Mayor wants to demolish as much lawn as possible (and replace it with road). On the other hand, he does not want to create a rapid widening or narrowing of the road, which would lead to car accidents. To avoid that, the Mayor decided that width of the road for consecutive parts should differ by at most $1$, i.e. for each $*i*$ ($1 ≤ *i* < *n*$) the inequation $|*s*'_{*i* + 1} - *s*'_{*i*}| ≤ 1$ should hold. Initially this condition might not be true.

You need to find the the total width of lawns the Mayor will destroy according to his plan.

## Input

The first line contains integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 2·10^{5}$) — number of parts of the street.

Each of the following $*n*$ lines contains two integers $*s*_{*i*}, *g*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *s*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{6}$, $0 ≤ *g*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{6}$) — current width of road and width of the lawn on the $*i*$-th part of the street.

## Output

In the first line print the total width of lawns which will be removed.

In the second line print $*n*$ integers $*s*'_{1}, *s*'_{2}, ..., *s*'_{*n*}$ ($*s*_{*i*} ≤ *s*'_{*i*} ≤ *s*_{*i*} + *g*_{*i*}$) — new widths of the road starting from the first part and to the last.

If there is no solution, print the only integer `-1` in the first line.
statementZhMd:
S 市市长非常讨厌树木和草坪。它们占据了太多空间，而这些地方本可以用来修路！

市长认为，城市的一条主干道可以利用反正无人需要的草坪进行大幅拓宽。此外，这或许还能帮助减少这条道路上时不时发生的交通拥堵。

这条道路从左到右被分成 $*n*$ 个等长部分，第 $*i*$ 个部分由两个整数表示：道路宽度 $*s*_{*i*}$ 和草坪宽度 $*g*_{*i*}$。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1e351a64cc735b32c3ed5bd9304d0d528a12a83e.png)

对于这 $*n*$ 个部分中的每一个，市长都需要决定要拆除多少草坪。对于第 $*i*$ 个部分，他可以将草坪宽度减少整数 $*x*_{*i*}$（$0 ≤ *x*_{*i*} ≤ *g*_{*i*}$）。这样，道路的新宽度将变为 $*s*'_{*i*} = *s*_{*i*} + *x*_{*i*}$，草坪的新宽度将变为 $*g*'_{*i*} = *g*_{*i*} - *x*_{*i*}$。

一方面，市长希望拆除尽可能多的草坪（并将其替换为道路）。另一方面，他不希望道路出现突然的拓宽或变窄，因为这可能导致交通事故。为避免这种情况，市长规定相邻部分的道路宽度之差最多为 $1$，即对于每个 $*i*$（$1 ≤ *i* < *n*$），都必须满足不等式 $|*s*'_{*i* + 1} - *s*'_{*i*}| ≤ 1$。初始状态下，这一条件可能并不满足。

你需要求出按照市长的方案将拆除的草坪总宽度。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 2·10^{5}$）——道路的部分数。

接下来的 $*n*$ 行中，每行包含两个整数 $*s*_{*i*}, *g*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *s*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{6}$，$0 ≤ *g*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{6}$）——道路第 $*i*$ 个部分当前的道路宽度和草坪宽度。

## 输出格式

第一行输出将被拆除的草坪总宽度。

第二行输出 $*n*$ 个整数 $*s*'_{*1}, *s*'_{*2}, ..., *s*'_{*n*$}$（$*s*_{*i*} ≤ *s*'_{*i*} ≤ *s*_{*i*} + *g*_{*i*}$）——从第一个部分到最后一个部分的新道路宽度。

如果无解，则仅在第一行输出整数 `-1`。
